meta.title: TE102 助听器（含电视伴侣 + APP）用户内测问卷
meta.titleEn: TE102 Hearing Aid (with TV Streamer + APP) User Beta Survey
meta.description: 面向真实用户的内测回收。①定位目标人群/分群；②验证需求是否被满足；③把反馈直接映射到迭代方向。
meta.descriptionEn: Beta testing feedback from real users. ①Identify target user segments; ②Validate whether needs are met; ③Map feedback directly to iteration priorities.

scoringGuide.rating1_5: 1=非常差/完全不符合，2=较差，3=一般/还行，4=较好，5=非常好/完全符合
scoringGuide.distance: 分别就"1米内"和"3米外"各打一次分
scoringGuide.distanceEn: Rate separately for "within 1 meter" and "beyond 3 meters"

sections.title: 一、人群定位（你是谁 / 你的痛点）
sections.titleEn: 1. User Profiling (Who You Are / Your Pain Points)
sections.description: 先做这9题筛人，再进行真实佩戴体验后答其余题目。
sections.descriptionEn: Complete these 9 screening questions first, then answer the rest after real wearing experience.

questions.text: 您的年龄区间是？
questions.textEn: What is your age range?
questions.purpose: 确认主力年龄段，验证RIC耳背形态与对应年龄层的操作、外观接受度是否匹配。
questions.purposeEn: Confirm the primary age group and verify whether the RIC BTE form factor matches the operation and appearance acceptance of that age group.

questions.text: 您觉得自己听力下降的程度？
questions.textEn: How would you rate your hearing loss?
optionsEn: Moderate: often ask people to repeat
questions.purpose: 验证目标为轻中度OTC人群，并前置筛掉重度（需转诊医疗）用户，降低错误购买。
questions.purposeEn: Validate target as mild-to-moderate OTC users; pre-screen severe loss users (who need medical referral) to reduce incorrect purchases.

questions.text: 您最主要的听觉困难场景是哪些？（可多选）
questions.textEn: What are your main hearing difficulty situations? (Select all that apply)
questions.purpose: 定位首要痛点场景，判断产品应主推居家/电视还是户外/会议，并据此分群。
questions.purposeEn: Identify primary pain point scenarios; determine whether the product should focus on home/TV or outdoor/meetings, and segment users accordingly.

questions.text: 您每天看电视或视频大约多久？
questions.textEn: About how long do you watch TV or videos each day?
questions.purpose: 验证"电视痛点"是否为高频刚需。
questions.purposeEn: Validate whether the "TV pain point" is a high-frequency essential need.

questions.text: 家人是否抱怨过您看电视音量开得太大？
questions.textEn: Has your family ever complained that you turn the TV volume too high?
questions.purpose: 验证"家庭音量冲突"这一电视伴侣首要价值点是否成立。
questions.purposeEn: Validate whether the "household volume conflict" — the primary value proposition of the TV streamer — holds true.

questions.text: 您是否戴过 / 买过助听器？结果如何？
questions.textEn: Have you ever worn / purchased a hearing aid? How did it go?
questions.textLabel: 如选"买过但退了"，请填写退货原因：
questions.textLabelEn: If you selected "Bought but returned", please specify the reason:
questions.textPlaceholder: 请描述退货原因（如啸叫、操作复杂等）
questions.textPlaceholderEn: Please describe the return reason (e.g., whistling, complicated operation)
questions.purpose: 识别退货高风险用户（尤其因啸叫、操作复杂退过货的），并获取竞品对比线索。
questions.purposeEn: Identify high return-risk users (especially those who returned due to whistling or complex operation), and gather competitive comparison insights.

questions.text: 您目前主要和谁同住？
questions.textEn: Who do you currently live with?
questions.purpose: 判断是否有家属可协助首次安装/调试，识别"服务依赖型"用户。
questions.purposeEn: Determine whether family members can assist with initial setup/adjustment; identify "service-dependent" users.

questions.text: 试戴后，您能接受"耳背挂机+入耳塞"这种外形吗？
questions.textEn: After trying it on, can you accept the "RIC + ear tip" appearance?
questions.purpose: 验证RIC形态的外观接受度（外观是退货因素之一）。
questions.purposeEn: Validate appearance acceptance of the RIC form factor (appearance is one of the return factors).

questions.text: 您是否理解：本产品主要改善"看电视和日常对话"，不承诺适用所有嘈杂环境？
questions.textEn: Do you understand that this product mainly improves "watching TV and daily conversation" and does not claim to work in all noisy environments?
questions.purpose: 降低期望错配导致的退货，确保用户与产品定位一致。
questions.purposeEn: Reduce returns caused by expectation mismatch; ensure users align with the product positioning.

questions.text: 戴上后耳塞贴合吗？松紧是否合适？
questions.textEn: After putting it on, does the ear tip fit well? Is the tightness appropriate?
questions.purpose: 验证耳塞规格覆盖度。
questions.purposeEn: Validate ear tip size coverage.

questions.text: 戴久了（如半小时以上），耳朵舒适吗？（不痛、不胀、不痒）
questions.textEn: After wearing for a while (e.g., over 30 minutes), how comfortable are your ears? (no pain, pressure, or itching)
questions.purpose: 验证长时间佩戴舒适性（声学报告要求>8h无疲劳/压痛）。
questions.purposeEn: Validate long-term wearing comfort (acoustic report requires >8h without fatigue/pain).

questions.text: 您自己说话时，声音听起来自然吗？（不闷、无回声、不像隔着东西/水）
questions.textEn: When you speak, does your voice sound natural? (not muffled, no echo, not like through something/water)
questions.purpose: 验证自声堵耳(occlusion)与回声问题（有回声、听感晕）。
questions.purposeEn: Validate own-voice occlusion and echo issues (echo causes dizziness).

questions.text: 戴眼镜/口罩、转头、咀嚼时，助听器佩戴稳固吗？（不移位、无啸叫）
questions.textEn: When wearing glasses/mask, turning head, or chewing, is the hearing aid securely in place? (no shifting, no whistling)
questions.purpose: 验证动态佩戴稳定性与啸叫安全（产品红线）。
questions.purposeEn: Validate dynamic wearing stability and feedback safety (product red line).

questions.text: 戴一整天后，您觉得舒适吗？（不累、不想摘下来）
questions.textEn: After wearing all day, how comfortable do you feel? (not tired, don't want to take it off)
questions.purpose: 验证整体听觉疲劳（声学报告要求>8h无疲劳/压痛）。
questions.purposeEn: Validate overall listening fatigue (acoustic report requires >8h without fatigue/pain).

questions.text: 开机、关机、调大/调小声音，您自己能顺手完成吗？
questions.textEn: Can you easily turn on/off and adjust volume by yourself?
questions.purpose: 验证基础操作门槛。
questions.purposeEn: Validate basic operation threshold.

questions.text: 切换模式（如室内/户外/电视）方便吗？四种听感模式是否有一款适合你？
questions.textEn: Is it easy to switch modes (e.g., indoor/outdoor/TV)? Is one of the four listening modes suitable for you?
questions.purpose: 验证模式实用性与适配度。
questions.purposeEn: Validate mode practicality and adaptability.

questions.text: 充电和看电量方便吗？一次充电大概能用多久？
questions.textEn: Is charging and checking battery level convenient? About how long does one charge last?
questions.textLabel: 请填写一次充电大约能用多久：
questions.textLabelEn: Please specify about how long one charge lasts:
questions.purpose: 验证续航与电量提示可用性。
questions.purposeEn: Validate battery life and battery indicator usability.

questions.text: 手机 App好用吗？若不好用，请在下方填写原因。
questions.textEn: Is the mobile App easy to use? If not, please describe the reasons below.
questions.textLabel: 若不好用，请填写具体原因：
questions.textLabelEn: If not easy to use, please specify the reasons:
questions.textPlaceholder: 如：界面复杂、连接不稳定、功能找不到等
questions.textPlaceholderEn: e.g., complex interface, unstable connection, hard to find features, etc.
questions.purpose: 验证App易用性。
questions.purposeEn: Validate App usability.

sections.title: 四、声音清晰度（安静 & 室内）

questions.text: 安静房间里，1米内、3米外，与人正常说话，能听清吗？（不是背对着人）
questions.textEn: In a quiet room, at 1 meter and beyond 3 meters, can you hear normal conversation clearly? (Not with your back to the person)
questions.purpose: 验证人声清晰度与距离衰减。
questions.purposeEn: Validate speech clarity and distance attenuation.

questions.text: 打电话时，对方声音清楚、连接稳定吗？（不断、不卡）
questions.textEn: During phone calls, is the other person's voice clear and the connection stable? (no dropouts, no stuttering)
questions.purpose: 验证电话/蓝牙通话质量与稳定性。
questions.purposeEn: Validate phone/Bluetooth call quality and stability.

questions.text: 听音乐时，乐器声音自然、分得开吗？
questions.textEn: When listening to music, do instruments sound natural and distinguishable?
questions.purpose: 验证音乐模式音质。
questions.purposeEn: Validate music mode sound quality.

questions.text: 您能大概判断声音从哪边来吗（左/右/前/后）？
questions.textEn: Can you roughly tell which direction sound comes from (left/right/front/back)?
questions.purpose: 验证空间方位感。
questions.purposeEn: Validate spatial directional awareness.

questions.text: 您自己/别人说话时，声音位置正常吗（不在头顶/胸腔）？
questions.textEn: When you/others speak, is the sound location normal (not in your head/chest)?
questions.purpose: 验证声像定位自然度，避免"声音在脑子里"的异物感。
questions.purposeEn: Validate natural sound localization; avoid the "sound in your head" foreign sensation.

sections.title: 五、降噪与啸叫（关键风险）

questions.text: 突然的响声（咳嗽、拍手、关门、电视广告）听起来舒适吗？（不刺耳、不吓人）
questions.textEn: Do sudden loud sounds (coughing, clapping, door slamming, TV commercials) sound comfortable? (not harsh, not startling)
questions.purpose: 验证突发声保护。
questions.purposeEn: Validate impulse sound protection.

questions.text: 正常佩戴时，靠近墙/书、用手捂耳，啸叫控制得好吗？（无尖叫=好）
questions.textEn: During normal wear, when near walls/books or covering ears with hands, how well is feedback controlled? (no whistling = good)
questions.purpose: 验证静态啸叫红线。
questions.purposeEn: Validate static feedback red line.

questions.text: 在马路上/有风时，人声清晰吗？（不被风声盖住、无"呜呜"响）
questions.textEn: On the street/windy conditions, is speech clear? (not drowned by wind, no 'whooshing')
questions.purpose: 验证风噪控制（户外风噪"呜呜"声风险）。
questions.purposeEn: Validate wind noise control (outdoor wind "whooshing" risk).

questions.text: 在菜市场/餐厅等嘈杂地方，人声清晰吗？（不被噪音盖住）
questions.textEn: In noisy places like markets/restaurants, is speech clear? (not drowned by noise)
questions.purpose: 验证嘈杂环境降噪与人声突出（环境音盖过人声、易晕）。
questions.purposeEn: Validate noisy environment noise reduction and speech emphasis (ambient noise drowning speech causes dizziness).

questions.text: 最小音量时，背景安静吗？（无电流声、无杂音）
questions.textEn: At minimum volume, is the background quiet? (no electrical hum, no noise)
questions.purpose: 验证底噪水平（最小音量有持续轻微电流杂音）。
questions.purposeEn: Validate noise floor level (persistent slight electrical hum at minimum volume).

sections.title: 六、场景验证（户外 / 嘈杂 / 电视 / 蓝牙）

questions.text: 户外散步和人对面说话，能听清吗？
questions.textEn: When walking outdoors and talking face-to-face, can you hear clearly?
questions.purpose: 验证户外模式在行走对话中的表现与人声锁定。
questions.purposeEn: Validate outdoor mode performance in walking conversation and speech locking.

questions.text: 在餐厅/多人聊天时，能跟上对话吗？
questions.textEn: In restaurants/group conversations, can you follow the dialogue?
questions.purpose: 验证嘈杂社交场景（用于标定产品能力边界）。
questions.purposeEn: Validate noisy social scenarios (used to calibrate product capability boundaries).

questions.text: 看电视时（配电视伴侣），台词清楚吗？
questions.textEn: When watching TV (with TV streamer), are dialogue lines clear?
questions.yesnoLabel: 不需要开很大声或字幕，也能听清吗？
questions.yesnoLabelEn: Can you hear clearly without turning up the volume or using subtitles?
questions.purpose: 验证电视伴侣首要价值（电视台词清晰度）。
questions.purposeEn: Validate TV streamer primary value (TV dialogue clarity).

questions.text: 看电视时，声音和画面对得上吗（没有明显延迟/回声）？
questions.textEn: When watching TV, does audio sync with video (no noticeable delay/echo)?
questions.purpose: 验证音画同步。
questions.purposeEn: Validate audio-video synchronization.

questions.text: 看电视时，家人觉得电视音量变小、少打扰了吗？
questions.textEn: When watching TV, does your family feel the TV volume is lower and less disturbing?
questions.note: 本题需由同住家属作答
questions.noteEn: This question must be answered by a family member living with you
questions.purpose: 从家属维度验证"家庭音量冲突"是否真正解决。
questions.purposeEn: Validate from the family perspective whether the "household volume conflict" is truly resolved.

questions.text: 连接蓝牙听手机/电视，连接稳定吗？（不断连、不卡顿、左右耳声音同步）
questions.textEn: When connected via Bluetooth to phone/TV, is the connection stable? (no disconnection, no stuttering, left-right audio in sync)
questions.purpose: 验证蓝牙稳定性（蓝牙卡顿、电流音、左右不同步）。
questions.purposeEn: Validate Bluetooth stability (Bluetooth stuttering, electrical hum, left-right desync).

questions.text: 整体来说，哪些情况下戴着效果最好？（请具体写）
questions.textEn: Overall, in which situations does it work best? (Please be specific)
questions.hint: 提示：建议写清楚具体场景，例如在哪里、和谁在一起、距离多远、环境安静还是嘈杂。
questions.hintEn: Tip: Please describe the specific situation — e.g., where you were, with whom, at what distance, and whether the environment was quiet or noisy.
questions.placeholder: 请具体描述效果最好的场景
questions.placeholderEn: Please specifically describe the scenarios where it works best
questions.purpose: 定位产品优势场景，为卖点与人群匹配提供依据。
questions.purposeEn: Identify product advantage scenarios; provide basis for selling points and user matching.

questions.text: 最不满意、最想改善的是什么？（请尽量具体，如哪种环境听不清哪种声音不舒服）
questions.textEn: What are you most dissatisfied with and most want improved? (Please be as specific as possible, e.g., which environment is unclear, which sound is uncomfortable)
questions.hint: 提示：建议写清楚哪种环境、什么声音、怎么听不清或不舒服；也可写功能或操作上希望改进的地方。
questions.hintEn: Tip: Please specify which environment, what kind of sound, and how it was unclear or uncomfortable; you may also mention features or operations you'd like improved.
questions.placeholderEn: Please be as specific as possible
questions.purpose: 定位首要整改项，直接对接迭代优先级。
questions.purposeEn: Identify primary improvement items; directly map to iteration priorities.

questions.text: 如果把这套产品给同样看电视困难的亲友，您愿意推荐吗？
questions.textEn: If you gave this product to a friend/relative who also has difficulty watching TV, how likely would you be to recommend it?
questions.purpose: 验证口碑与推荐意愿（NPS）。
questions.purposeEn: Validate word-of-mouth and recommendation willingness (NPS).

questions.text: 试用结束后，您愿意继续每天佩戴使用吗？
questions.textEn: After the trial period, would you be willing to continue wearing it daily?
questions.purpose: 验证留存意愿与退货红线（不愿用≈高退货风险）。
questions.purposeEn: Validate retention willingness and return red line (unwilling to use ≈ high return risk).

questions.text: 您觉得这个产品，对得起它的价格吗？
questions.textEn: Do you feel this product is worth its price?
questions.purpose: 验证价格与价值匹配度。
questions.purposeEn: Validate price-value match.
